mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals a strengthening demand in the economy, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points within 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage costs and reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within a month signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening consumer demand and a tightening labor market, which together boost corporate earnings and lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a potential deflationary pressure, which increases real interest rates and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 within a month signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real GDP (GDPC1) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening economy with increased consumer demand and a tightening labor market, which together boost corporate earnings and lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases > 1% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3pp in 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.
